properties.description: Drives the served surface in-process: enumerates every settle path from the tools own _meta["reflow2/settles"] declaration, signs each with the person through the request _meta route naming the agent, and reads the export: every approver edge carries approved_via = [the agent], the agent is ACTS_FOR the person, and the agent is never an author or approver. Also: a credited write carries authored_via; the session declaration and the client handshake name each name the agent (a stranger client names nobody and nothing is minted); loop_status assigned decisions say acted_through or "no agent known"; a settle with no approver through an agent still carries nobody name; an unknown agent and a person named as the agent are refused before anything is written. The core file pins stamping, role-scoping, the generic edge path, self-exclusion, refusals, client matching and export/import.
properties.findings: Failing first on a clean origin/main build (db305d4) under the shared build lock: 6 of 7 failed (every settle path named [] as approved_via; a credited write carried no authored_via; writes_for refused acting_agent as unknown; no acted_through note; an unknown agent was not refused; the client name found nothing); the 7th, naming an agent signs nothing, passed as regression cover. On the fix: 7 of 7 pass, core 8 of 8, and the neighbouring suites (writes_for, settles, revise, globals, bulk draw_edges, receipts, find_tools ranking, derived relations, tools, lens, loop_status) pass after merging #629, #630 and #631.
properties.name: Every settle path and a credited write record the agent beside the person; a session, a request and the client name each name it; no agent known is said plainly; naming an agent signs nothing; an unknown or person agent is refused
